description: This file defines the class TemplateParentType, which extends TemplateText and customizes the get_field_def() method to specify database attributes for a 'parent_type' field in the SuiteCRM module.

classes.name: TemplateParentType
classes.description: A class that extends TemplateText to create a specialized field type with specific database attributes.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Overrides parent method to modify the field definition, setting 'dbType' to 'varchar' and hiding the field in Studio.
